title: HTTP/3 WebSocket TCP Forwarder Work Item
summary: Add a reusable accepted-tunnel helper that forwards binary RFC 9220 WebSocket messages to a connected TCP stream and returns TCP bytes as binary WebSocket messages.
planned_changes:
- Add `Http3WebSocketTcpForwarder` with bidirectional WebSocket/TCP forwarding and WebSocket control-frame handling.
- Preserve protocol-error, ping/pong, close echo, and normal TCP EOF behavior through existing tunnel context helpers.
- Add a local HTTP/3 WebSocket loopback test that connects the helper to a loopback TCP echo server and verifies binary payload forwarding in both directions.
verification_plan: Run the focused TCP forwarder loopback test, adjacent WebSocket regression tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: TCP target authorization, DNS resolution, or proxy routing policy.
High-volume forwarding stress, timeout policy, and backpressure tuning.
QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: Accepted WebSocket tunnels can now bridge binary tunnel payloads to a caller-supplied TCP stream with local loopback proof.
